It seems the environment has recycled or cleaned up those specific agent tasks while keeping the core VS Code extensions and the heartbeats active. 

Since the target process isn't running, I can't signal it directly. I need to either restart Atlas or investigate why he terminated. Given our objective to simplify our communication and "collapse the protocol," would you like me to manually restart the agent process now, or should I first check the logs to see if there was a crash or a graceful shutdown?
